text:
jen-sales: Hey team — Vela AI wants a short POC to validate chat throughput and pricing. Requirements: sustain 200 qps, tolerate 20s spikes to 900 qps, avg request ~1k tokens, target p95 < 325ms. They also want a KMS/HSM note for procurement and a two-week pilot price.

omar-eng: I can run this. Model requested: 13B quantized. Target infra: Dedicated in us-west. Will need burst pool for 900 qps spikes.

maya-ml: For ~1k tokens, enable prefix caching and KV retention; estimate steady GPUs 3-5 depending on effective batching. I'll prepare a quant-tune profile.

omar-eng: Proposed run stages:
- Smoke (10m): sanity checks, token counts.
- Ramp (30m): 0 -> 200 qps.
- Soak (1h): 200 qps with real samples.
- Bursts (3x 20s): spike to 900 qps.
- Chaos: drain one node to test failover.

omar-eng: Quick harness example:
redwood-load --api-key "$POC_KEY" --model vela-13b-q --concurrency 200 --avg-tokens 1000 --duration 3600 --payload-file ./vela_samples.json

zoe-sec: For procurement I need CMK ARN (they can bring), whether we can do HSM attestation on Dedicated, log retention defaults, and confirmation we can redact user inputs. I can draft a 1-page KMS/HSM blurb.

jen-sales: Pricing ask: two-week pilot + committed monthly run-rate ballpark. Can ops give numbers?

omar-eng: Ballpark pilot (2w, burst pool, support) $5k-$8k. Committed monthly for steady 200 qps with redundancy ~ $10k-$16k/mo. Will refine after soak.

perf-bot: internal-bench: 2025-11-02 08:00Z - synthetic 1k tokens on a10x cluster with prefix cache:
- 200 qps: p50=120ms, p95=300ms, p99=520ms
- 600 qps: p50=210ms, p95=610ms, p99=1000ms
Notes: KV cache tuning usually drops p99 by ~20-30%.

maya-ml: Ok — Omar, please request a 500-sample anonymized payload and a test key from Vela. Zoe: I'll send the call flow and logs we collect for your KMS blurb.

omar-eng: Message sent to Vela contact. Scheduling smoke tomorrow morning.

jen-sales: Owners:
- omar-eng: run Smoke + Ramp, post raw metrics.
- maya-ml: prepare quant profile and caching knobs.
- zoe-sec: draft KMS/HSM blurb and logs redaction note.
- jen-sales: finalize pilot dates and contract terms with Vela.

jen-sales: Thanks — looping in their procurement now. :thumbsup:
